deviation: The draft is one-sided: Arcadia (Customer) needs the Supplier's consent to assign or subcontract, while the Supplier can freely assign to any affiliate or business successor and subcontract without Arcadia's consent. Arcadia could end up with an unvetted counterparty or subcontractors handling its data and services, and it loses the mutual consent right in the playbook.
suggested_text: Neither party may assign, transfer or subcontract any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the other party's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
